currentFocus.title: Define the new V2 product behavior

currentStage.title: Define the new V2 product behavior

baselineSource.result: V2 was created first as an exact Git tree clone of the frozen V1 workstream, preserving V1 unchanged.

namespaceIsolation.samePageConstraint: V1 and V2 still share window.MarketFlow* internal globals, so do not inject both into the same page context without refresh. Separate tabs are isolated by persistent/runtime identity.

bootstrapFailureReview.technicalRootCause: The first V2 adaptation omitted two inherited HOT-context discoverability phrases and left one viewer-recovery assertion on the V1 marker.
bootstrapFailureReview.processCause: The clone-to-V2 identity pass changed documentation/runtime identity surfaces before systematically preserving every existing guard contract.
bootstrapFailureReview.escapeCause: The exact clone was correct, but V2-specific edits were broader than the initial literal checklist.
bootstrapFailureReview.prevention: Existing context-architecture and Browser regression tests remain the prevention; do not weaken them. Future identity forks should use those guards as the migration checklist.
bootstrapFailureReview.promotionDecision: No new repository-wide rule added; the existing guards already caught the class of error.

verification.specImpact: Product-level direction was captured in docs/product/live-opportunity-discovery.md. No runtime/product behavior was implemented and no V2 normative spec changed yet.

next.action: Continue defining the broader product requirements, then map the approved subset into V2-specific specs before implementation.
steps: Continue capturing broad Market Flow product vision and related product ideas under docs/product without turning them into implementation status.
Separate stable product requirements from technical choices that still require benchmark or design evidence.
When the product direction is sufficiently clear, classify the V2-relevant behavior as retained, replaced or removed and update V2 specs/tests/implementation plan.

history.rule: V1 history inside this cloned tree is inherited cold baseline evidence. New V2 evidence is added separately and read only when needed.
